9:87.text: They are content to be with those
(from all kinds of goodness and right guidance)

9:88.text: and those who believed with him
strove hard and fought with their wealth and their lives
. Such are they for whom are the good things, and it is they who will be successful.

9:89.text: For them Allâh has got ready Gardens
under which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme success.

9:90.text: And those who made excuses from the bedouins came
(to you, O Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم)
asking your permission to exempt them
, and those who had lied to Allâh and His Messenger sat at home
; a painful torment will seize those of them who disbelieve.

9:91.text: There is no blame on those who are weak or ill or who find no resources to spend
, if they are sincere and true
can there be against the Muhsinûn
. And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

9:92.text: on those who came to you to be provided with mounts, when you said: "I can find no mounts for you," they turned back, while their eyes overflowing with tears of grief that they could not find anything to spend

9:93.text: is only against those who are rich, and yet ask exemption.
They are content to be with
and Allâh has sealed up their hearts
(from all kinds of goodness and right guidance)
